title: The Sign Under Test: Revelation 12 Against the Frozen Operator
creator: Sharks, Lee
description: Executes the sealed test pre-registered in The Transform Signature, Frozen (#1494): Revelation 12, whole, in Greek, scored station by station against the twelve-clause Sappho 31 reception operator under the declared criterion d(R12,S31) < d(B,S31), with the biblical source-set fixed in advance and every pericope adjudicated from its verbatim Greek. Scoring rule fixed before adjudication: per station, Revelation-presence and B-coverage each graded 0–2, direction = presence minus coverage, doubled where Revelation contradicts its source toward the apparatus; a station passes at direction ≥ 1; the pre-set support threshold is four passing stations including one double-weight. RESULT: eight of nine stations pass (direction-sum 12), one doubled — C6, occlusion-as-gate, where Revelation demonstrably works Isaiah 66:7 (the shared ἄρσεν/ἄρρενα establishes the source) and reinserts the torment Isaiah explicitly removes, βασανιζομένη τεκεῖν against πρὶν ἐλθεῖν τὸν πόνον τῶν ὠδίνων ἐξέφυγεν. One full negative is reported: C1 fails — the apocalyptic seeing-frame is covered by Genesis 37 and Daniel 7, and the correlative instantaneity marker is absent from the chapter. Two negative sub-findings: the birth-cry is fully covered by Isaiah 26:17 and scores nothing; the reactivation lacks the fire-lexeme. Clean post-freeze findings include the accuser exercising the voice-channel day and night in the facing position (12:10), the ψυχή-station's polarity flip against Esther's κατελειπόμην ὑπὸ τῆς ψυχῆς (12:11 οὐκ ἠγάπησαν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτῶν ἄχρι θανάτου), the systematic shedding profile matching the Judaic-prose carrier exactly, and the collapse-limb inverted to flight on given wings. Contamination from the pre-freeze pass is flagged per station and never scored. Verdict, calibrated to the pre-registered ladder: Revelation 12's redaction of its biblical materials realizes, at eight of nine independently specified stations, the relational apparatus attested in the ancient reception of Sappho 31, and at one doubly-weighted station contradicts its source in the apparatus's direction. The identification sentence is deliberately not asserted; the demonstration it would require now exists as a record.

wiki_article: The Sign Under Test: Revelation 12 Against the Frozen Operator is a philological test report executing the pre-registered protocol of The Transform Signature, Frozen. Revelation 12 is scored in Greek against the twelve-clause Sappho 31 reception operator, with a declared biblical source-set (Genesis 37, Micah 4, Isaiah 26:17 and 66:7–9, Psalm 2, Daniel 7) adjudicated verbatim and a scoring rule fixed before adjudication. Eight of nine stations pass with a direction-sum of twelve. The doubled station is occlusion-as-gate: Revelation 12:5's ἔτεκεν υἱόν ἄρρενα imports Isaiah 66:7's ἔτεκεν ἄρσεν, establishing the source under the author's hand, and against that verse's explicit painless birth Revelation writes βασανιζομένη τεκεῖν — the torment reinserted into the verse that removed it. One station fails outright: the apocalyptic seeing-frame is covered by Genesis and Daniel and the correlative instantaneity marker is absent. Reported negatives include the birth-cry, fully covered by Isaiah 26:17, and the absence of the fire-lexeme at reactivation. Clean post-freeze findings include the accuser exercising the voice-channel day and night in the facing position, the soul-station's polarity flip against the Esther realization, the shedding profile matching the Judaic-prose carrier, and collapse inverted to flight on given wings. The verdict is held to the pre-registered ladder; the identification sentence is deliberately not asserted, and substrate-blind replication of the scoring is invited.
